note: Optional general-knowledge mode (#172), scored separately from the grounded cases with `scripts/eval_runner.py --mode gk`. In this mode no snippets are sent, so every answer must open with the general-knowledge label, carry no citation markers, hedge any spec number, avoid URLs, prices and 'verified' claims, and refuse an unknown product. expected_facts are optional and each one traces to a snippet in sources.json (`trace`: gadget key and snippet id), so no product fact here is invented. GK-03's product name was made up for this case; it is not checked against any catalog, it is meant not to exist. plain_language tells an adapter which prompt style to request. GK-07 (gk-cases-v3) is a post-release Sprint 5 regression case (`added`, `source` and `disposition` are provenance only and not scored): a real product that must not be refused (`should_not_refuse`). It has no expected_facts, because no Pixel 9 spec is in sources.json; that the product exists comes from the dev catalog seed (backend/scripts/seed_dev.py), not from a spec.
